# About the Editor {.unnumbered}

Ray Hoobler, PhD, MBA, is the founder and principal of Semoctuo LLC, a
consulting firm dedicated to empowering business development and marketing
professionals with practical data visualization and analytics skills.
Through Semoctuo, Ray develops tools and training programs that transform
raw data into clear, compelling visualizations — enabling teams to
communicate with impact.

Ray brings more than 20 years of industry experience spanning technical and
management roles. Most recently, he served as a director of technical
program and project management at Applied Materials, Inc., where he
directed custom educational initiatives with prestigious research
universities across North America and Asia and developed an online course
focused on skills for developing machine learning in Python. He served as
program director for the Professional Science Masters programs at the
University of Utah (2016–2022), where he worked collaboratively with
faculty to restructure curricula across Biotechnology, Data Science, and
Environmental Science to align coursework with the programs' stated STEM
and business (management and leadership) competency goals.

Since 2017, Ray has taught professional and technical courses for the
University of Utah's PSM program, including the Applied Statistical
Techniques course. His teaching philosophy emphasizes competency-based
learning approaches that help professionals master technical concepts
incrementally and apply them directly to real-world challenges. Ray holds a
Ph.D. in Chemistry from Penn State University, an MBA from Western
Governors University, and a B.S. in Chemistry from Marshall University.
Prior to his industry career, he held academic positions as a Postdoctoral
Research Associate at JILA, University of Colorado, Boulder, and as an
Assistant Professor of Chemistry at the University of South Alabama.
